title: Functions and Methods
description: Write small, focused functions that do one thing well.

data.text: **Clean functions** are small, focused, and do exactly one thing. They should be easy to read, understand, and test.

items: Functions should be small (ideally under 20 lines)
Do one thing and do it well

data.title: Bad vs Good Functions
Key Takeaways
points: Extract helper functions to keep methods small
Use descriptive names that reveal intent
data.takeaway: Write functions that tell a story and are easy to understand at a glance.
